## How I checked it
- [ ] `npm run test:unit` is green
- [ ] I added or updated tests for the behaviour
- [ ] UI change: screenshot attached
- [ ] If something new leaves the PC, the README says so
- [ ] New action: it is a tool with a tier, a schema and (if possible) an undo; text from other people is returned `untrusted: true`
